description.value: Eric's Meat Market & Deli is a cornerstone of downtown Kaslo with over 80 years of continuous operation, originally part of Burns & Co. before becoming a community institution under its current family ownership. The shop hand-cuts fresh meats daily and produces house-made sausages, smoked fish, and beef jerky using traditional recipes — making it a standout provisioning stop for cyclists touring the Kootenays. The deli counter carries imported and Canadian cheeses, cold cuts, and ready-to-eat specialties well suited to a lakeside picnic.
